verses.text: Ix yalanxi Jehová t'ayin icha tik:
¿Tas yuj hanheja' eyalub'tanhan jun lolonel t'a spatik chonhab' Israel: Ha heb' mamab'il slo pajal uwa heb', haxo heb' uninab'il jululixonhej sb'at spajil chi' t'a yichtak ye heb'?
Ha in Jehová Yajal in swala' to a jun lolonel chi' manhxa b'ak'inh ol eyalub'tanhej a ex aj Israel ex tik.
Yujto wik yaj masanil anima, heb' mamab'il yet' pax heb' uninab'il. Ha mach tz'och smul, ha' schami.
K'inalok ay junok winh winak tojol spensar, wach'nhej tas sk'ulej winh.

Max och winh yet' heb' tz'ak'anoch k'inh t'a jolomtak witz yik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios. Max yak'och juntzanh skomon diosal heb' yetisraelal winh chi' yipok sk'o'ol. Max mulan winh yet' ix yetb'eyum junok yetanimail, max yil-laj sb'a winh yet' ix yetb'eyum ayik ayoch ix t'a sb'islab' uj.
Max yixtej junok yetanimail winh, palta to syak' meltzaj tas aykan t'a winh yuj junok anima ay sb'ok t'ay. Max elk'anwi winh. Syak' swa'el heb' ay swejel winh, syak'an spichul heb' malaj yiko'.

Max yak' k'e'en tumin winh t'a majanil yik sk'ananel niwan yune' k'e'en winh. Max yixtej junok yetanimail winh, palta wach' tz'aj sb'o'an yaj junok lolonel winh t'a yib'anh chawanhok ay owal t'a skal.
Sb'eyb'alan in cheknab'il winh yet' in k'ayb'ub'al. Ha junok winh winak icha chi', wal yel tojol ton sb'eyb'al winh, ol najatb'ok sk'inal winh, a in wal Jehová in swala'.
K'inalok ay junok yuninal jun winh winak chi' te elk'um, mato mak'umcham anima tz'aji. Sb'eyb'alej juntzanh tastak
maj sb'eyb'alej smam, palta to syak'och k'inh t'a jolomtak witz, tz'och ejmelal t'a yechel komon Dios, smulan pax yet' ix yetb'eyum junok yetanimail,

syixtan heb' anima ilb'ajk'ol yuj smheb'ail, tz'elk'anwi, max yak' meltzaj tas aykan t'ay yuj heb' ay sb'ok t'ay, anhej juntzanh komon Dios chi' syak'och yipok sk'o'ol, sk'ulan tas te yajb'entak t'a wichanh.

Ha stumin syak' majanil te niwan yune' sk'ana'. Ha junok anima icha chi' sb'eyb'al, ol tzapanb'ok sk'inal. Yujto ix sk'ulej juntzanh tastak tzin yaj chi', manh ol ek'b'atlaj schami. Ha schamel chi', ha t'a yib'anh skani.
K'inalok ay junok yuninal jun winak chuk sb'eyb'al chi', syila' tastak juntzanh chuk sk'ulej smam chi', palta manhok juntzanh chi' sk'ulej.
Max yak'och k'inh t'a jolomtak witz yik tz'och ejmelal t'a yechel komon Dios. Max yak'och son t'a juntzanh skomon diosal heb' yetisraelal. Max mulan yet' ix yetb'eyum junok yetanimail.
Max yixtej junok yetanimail, max elk'anwi, max kanlaj tas aykan t'ay yuj heb' ay sb'ok t'ay. Syak' swa'el heb' malaj swa'el, syak'an spichul heb' malaj yiko'.

Malaj junok mach syixtej yujto a stumin syak' majanil manh niwanok yune' sk'ana'. Sb'eyb'alan in cheknab'il yet' in k'ayb'ub'al. Ha jun anima icha chi', manh ol cham yuj smul smam chi', palta to ol najatb'ok sk'inal.
Haxo smam chi' ol cham yuj smul chi', yujto ixtum anima, elk'um, te chuk tas ix sk'ulej t'a yol schonhab'.

Tato ayex ol he k'anb'ej icha tik: ¿Tas yuj max kotkan t'a yib'anh heb' uninab'il yuj smul smam? tato xe chi. Tato a yuninal chi' anhej tas wach' yet' tojolal sk'ulej, sk'anab'ajan in k'ayb'ub'al, ol najatb'ok sk'inal.

Ha mach tz'och smul, a ol chamok. Manhok heb' uninab'il ol tupanel smul smam, manhok pax heb' mamab'il chi' ol tupanel smul heb' yuninal chi'. Ha mach wach' sb'eyb'al, wach' spak ol scha'a, haxo pax mach chuk sb'eyb'al, a chukal ol scha spakok schukal chi'.
Tato ay junok anima chuk sb'eyb'al tz'aktankan schukal chi', sb'eyb'alan masanil in cheknab'il, sb'eyb'alanpax tojolal, wal yel a jun anima chi' manh ol pet chamok.
Ha in tik, manhxo ol in nakot juntzanh chukal ix sk'ulej chi', ol najatb'ok sk'inal yujto a tojolal sk'ulej.
Ha in Jehová in swala': Malaj in gana scham heb' chuk sb'eyb'al, palta in gana to sk'ex sb'eyb'al heb' yik snajatb'i sk'inal heb'.

Tato a junok anima wach' sb'eyb'al, palta syaktejkan sk'ulan wach'il chi', haxo juntzanh tas yajb'entak sk'ulej heb' chuk, a chi' sk'ulej, ¿tom ol wak' najatb'ok sk'inal jun anima chi' tze na'a? Manhxo ol in nakot tastak wach' ix sk'ulej chi'. Ol cham yuj chukal sk'ulej chi'.
Ha ex tik tzeyala' to manh tojolok tas tzin k'ulej, yuj chi' ab'ek ex aj Israel: ¿Yel am wal to manh tojolok tas tzin k'ulej chi'? ¿Tom manhok ex tze k'ulej tas manh tojolok chi' jun?
Tato a junok anima wach' sb'eyb'al, syaktejkan sk'ulan wach'il chi', haxo chukal sk'ulej, ol cham yuj chukal sk'ulej chi'.
Palta tato a junok anima chuk sb'eyb'al, syaktejkan schukal chi', haxo wach'il yet' tojolal sk'ulej, ol kolchaj t'a yol sk'ab' chamel.
Yujto ix nachajel yuj ix yaktankan schukal sk'ulej chi', wal yel manh ol chamlaj, ol najatb'ok sk'inal.
Ha exxo aj Israel ex tik, hanhejtona' tzeyala' to manh tojolok tas tzin k'ulej. ¿Tom manhok ex manh tojolok tas tze k'ulej chi' jun?

Ha in Jehová Yajal in swala': Ol ex in ch'olb'itej junjun ex icha tas tze k'ulej. Yuj chi' naek he b'a, aktejekkan he chuk b'eyb'al chi' t'a junelnhej. Tato ma'ay, yuj he chuk b'eyb'alil chi' ol ex satelok.
Ex israel, ¿tom tze nib'ej cham he b'a yuj chi' max he k'ex he pensar yet' he b'eyb'al? Palta aktejekkan masanil chukal tze k'ulej chi' yik manh ol ex chamok.
Ha in Jehová in swala', malaj in gana to ay mach schami. Aktejekkan chukal chi' yik ol najatb'ok he k 'inal, xchi Jehová.
